outcome: need for epidural rescue anesthesia during Combined Spinal-Epidural (CSE) for cesarean section
cohort: 230 patients who underwent Combined Spinal-Epidural (CSE) for cesarean delivery at Toulouse University Hospital, France, between 2020 and 2022.
finding: Gestational diabetes, postpartum hemorrhage, and surgical duration exceeding 62 minutes were identified as independent predictors for the need of epidural rescue during CSE for cesarean delivery.
